judge.rationale: The candidate only added a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`) and a new acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping after the TDD red phase without actually implementing the feature. None of the production code in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` was modified to accumulate `outcome.usage`, so the newly added tests will fail directly on `npm test`. Furthermore, none of the required updates to `OrchestratorHooks`, `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, or `CHANGELOG.md` were made. While the acceptance test cases themselves are well-written and accurately target the issue's scenarios, the submission is completely unfinished and broken.
